title: Journal Club 2, Preview - The Broken Science Initiative
abstract:
# JOURNAL CLUB #2 PREVIEW  
Conducted July 25, 2024, this meeting of the BSI Journal Club explored the 2014 study “[Low Protein Intake Is Associated with a Major Reduction in IGF-1, Cancer, and Overall Mortality in the 65 and Younger but Not Older Population](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24606898/)” published in*Cell Metabolism*.  
A short preview of the meeting is provided here for you to view, free of charge. A full archive of the meeting is available for BSI Medical Society Members or can be purchased for $250.  
Bob Kaplan is an independent research analyst. Bob previously served as director of research at Early Medical, contributing to The Drive podcast with Peter Attia and its other properties. Kaplan was a researcher at the Nutrition Science Initiative (NuSI), and an exercise physiologist at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas. His current and previous research interests include meta-research, chronic diseases, bioenergetics, exercise physiology, and nutrition.
